items.docs: Permanently deletes a custom compliance framework identified by its numeric id. Only frameworks created by your organisation can be deleted. Qualio-managed frameworks (built-in standards such as ISO 13485 or GDPR) cannot be deleted and will return a 403 if you attempt to do so. Deletion removes the framework and its associated requirements from your instance. This action cannot be undone. A successful deletion returns no content.
